程序包 org.bukkit

接口 BanList<T>

类型参数:
T - 封禁目标

原文：The ban target

所有已知子接口:
IpBanList, ProfileBanList
public interface BanList<T>
一个封禁列表，包含了一些封禁类型

原文： A ban list, containing bans of some BanList.Type.

      @Deprecated(since="1.20.1") @Nullable <E extends BanEntry<? super T>> E getBanEntry(@NotNull @NotNull java.lang.String target)
      已过时。
      see getBanEntry(Object)
      Gets a BanEntry by target.

      Bans by name for ban type NAME are no longer supported and this method will return null when trying to request them. The replacement is bans by UUID.

      参数:
      target - entry parameter to search for
      返回:
      the corresponding entry, or null if none found

      @Nullable @Nullable BanEntry<T> getBanEntry(@NotNull T target)
      根据封禁目标(IP地址或玩家资料)来获取对应的 BanEntry.

    • addBan

      @Deprecated(since="1.20.1") @Nullable <E extends BanEntry<? super T>> E addBan(@NotNull @NotNull java.lang.String target, @Nullable @Nullable java.lang.String reason, @Nullable @Nullable java.util.Date expires, @Nullable @Nullable java.lang.String source)
      已过时。
      see addBan(Object, String, Date, String)
      Adds a ban to this list. If a previous ban exists, this will update the previous entry.

      Bans by name for ban type NAME are no longer supported and this method will return null when trying to request them. The replacement is bans by UUID.

      参数:
      target - the target of the ban
      reason - reason for the ban, null indicates implementation default
      expires - date for the ban's expiration (unban), or null to imply forever
      source - source of the ban, null indicates implementation default
      返回:
      the entry for the newly created ban, or the entry for the (updated) previous ban

    • addBan

      @Nullable @Nullable BanEntry<T> addBan(@NotNull T target, @Nullable @Nullable java.lang.String reason, @Nullable @Nullable java.util.Date expires, @Nullable @Nullable java.lang.String source)
      添加一个封禁到这个列表。如果以前的封禁存在，这将更新以前的封禁.

      原文： Adds a ban to this list. If a previous ban exists, this will update the previous entry.

      参数:
      target - 封禁目标

      原文：the target of the ban

      reason - 封禁理由，null则使用默认

      原文：reason for the ban, null indicates implementation default

      expires - 封禁的截止日期(解除封禁)，null则为永远封禁

      原文：date for the ban's expiration (unban), or null to imply forever

      source - 封禁来源，null则使用默认

      原文：source of the ban, null indicates implementation default

      返回:
      新创建的封禁条目，或为更新之前的封禁

      原文：the entry for the newly created ban, or the entry for the (updated) previous ban

    • isBanned

      boolean isBanned(@NotNull T target)
      获取此目标的封禁状态.

      原文： Gets if a BanEntry exists for the target, indicating an active ban status.

      Bans by name for ban type NAME are no longer supported. The replacement is bans by UUID.

      参数:
      target - 寻找的目标

      原文：the target to find

      返回:
      如果BanEntry存在这个目标则表示被封禁了，否则为false

      原文：true if a BanEntry exists for the target, indicating an active ban status, false otherwise

    • pardon

      void pardon(@NotNull T target)
      从列表中移除指定目标，因此表示“无封禁”的状态(即解除封禁).

      原文： Removes the specified target from this list, therefore indicating a "not banned" status.

      Bans by name for ban type NAME are no longer supported. The replacement is bans by UUID.

      参数:
      target - 从这个列表移除的目标(解除封禁)

      原文：the target to remove from this list
